answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 65857 Country: INDIA Title: How to control anger? Question: Is there any dua or surah to control my anger? Please help me. Answer ID: 65857 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 850/850/M=09/1437) When someone feels anger he should sit if he is standing and lay down if he is sitting i.e. he should change his position and if possible he should make wudhu with cold water as it shall remove the heat of anger. He should also recite the following verse: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي السَّرَّاء وَالضَّرَّاء وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ وَاللّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ [آل عمران : 134] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
